data.long_meaning: The name Ripan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ripu' which means a joyful or pleasing person. The name Ripan carries the meaning “Joyful, pleasing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ripan usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ripan is a divine name, which signifies happiness and joy. It is believed that the name brings prosperity and success in life.
data.etymology: Ripan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, pleasing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ripan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
